name: v0.3.6 — engagement strip up top + swipe-back
releaseNotes:
• Engagement strip (GuacScore · GuacWizard · GuacMoney · Rewards with live values) promoted to the top of the dashboard, replacing the redundant 'Your score & insights' static cards.
• Swipe-from-left-edge anywhere now goes back to the previous screen (Cupertino-style page transitions enabled on every platform).
• New 'Check for update' pill on the Profile screen — manually triggers the same flow the auto-check fires, so you can pull updates on demand.
• In-app update detector reads getguac.app/downloads/latest.json so each new build prompts within seconds of opening the app.
